description: SNMPv3 authPriv polling and notification views. CPU comes from verified HOST-RESOURCES-MIB polling; trap panels show actual stored notifications and do not imply a native CPU threshold trap. Legacy/compatibility dashboard: its resource panels are superseded by NMAS Resources (nmas-resources) and its trap panels by NMAS Link Events (nmas-link-events); retained unchanged for existing links.

panels.description: Last stored SNMP poll and device uptime. Polling is run by the verification workflow, not a background scheduler.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "network-monitoring")
          |> range(start: -30d)
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "snmp_poll" and r.metric == "sysUpTime" and r._field == "value")
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device =~ /^${device:regex}$/)
          |> group(columns: ["device", "platform", "management_ip"])
          |> last()
          |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with uptime_seconds: float(v: r._value) / 100.0, poll_age_seconds: float(v: int(v: now()) - int(v: r._time)) / 1000000000.0}))
          |> keep(columns: ["device", "platform", "management_ip", "_time", "poll_age_seconds", "uptime_seconds"])
          |> group()
          |> sort(columns: ["device"])

panels.title: SNMP poll freshness

targets.query:
from(bucket: "network-monitoring")
          |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "snmp_poll" and r.metric == "cpu" and r._field == "value")
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device =~ /^${device:regex}$/)
          |> group(columns: ["device"])
          |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
          |> last()

panels.description: Latest polled IF-MIB operational state; 1=UP, every other standard state is counted non-UP.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "network-monitoring")
          |> range(start: -30d)
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "snmp_poll" and r.metric == "ifOperStatus" and r._field == "value")
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device =~ /^${device:regex}$/)
          |> group(columns: ["device", "interface"])
          |> last()
          |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: if r._value == 1 then 0 else 1}))
          |> group()
          |> sum()

panels.description: IF-MIB integer state values: 1 up, 2 down, 3 testing; operational states may also use 4-7 per IF-MIB.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "network-monitoring")
          |> range(start: -30d)
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "snmp_poll" and (r.metric == "ifAdminStatus" or r.metric == "ifOperStatus") and r._field == "value")
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device =~ /^${device:regex}$/)
          |> group(columns: ["device", "platform", "interface", "ifindex", "metric"])
          |> last()
          |> group(columns: ["device", "platform", "interface", "ifindex"])
          |> pivot(rowKey: ["device", "platform", "interface", "ifindex"], columnKey: ["metric"], valueColumn: "_value")
          |> group()
          |> sort(columns: ["device", "interface"])

panels.title: Trap types

panels.description: Event time, canonical device/source, notification class/OID, optional interface index, and decoded varbinds. CPU values are polled; no native CPU trap is claimed.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "network-monitoring")
          |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "snmp_trap" and r._field == "raw_varbinds")
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device =~ /^${device:regex}$/)
          |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with ifindex: if exists r.ifindex then r.ifindex else "-"}))
          |> keep(columns: ["_time", "device", "source_ip", "event_type", "severity", "ifindex", "notification_oid", "_value"])
          |> rename(columns: {_value: "raw_varbinds"})
          |> group()
          |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
          |> limit(n: 200)

panels.title: Recent SNMP notifications

panels.description: NMAS/collector-generated CPU threshold events derived from repeated real SNMP CPU polls (measurement collector_alert, source=collector) -- distinct from the device-originated SNMP notifications above (measurement snmp_trap). Never implies a device-emitted CPU trap. verification=true rows are the safe, clearly-labelled deterministic self-test evidence.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "network-monitoring")
          |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "collector_alert" and r.alert_type == "cpu_threshold")
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device =~ /^${device:regex}$/)
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "cpu_value" or r._field == "threshold_pct" or r._field == "consecutive_samples" or r._field == "previous_state")
          |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "device", "source", "severity", "transition", "monitoring_method", "verification"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
          |> group()
          |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
          |> limit(n: 200)
